verdicts.reason: A and B are almost pixel-identical, so they share the same flaws. The background photo is badly blurred from upscaling and cropped to a hazy close-up, so the tower bridge and river panorama from the original are lost. The translucent panel has nearly vanished, which leaves the small dark 'FAMILY DAYS OUT IN' and 'Save your money' text on a busy, low-contrast skyline. The '<<<' chevrons float off to the right of the headline, away from the text column. The text block is jammed into the top-centre and the rest of the frame is dead photo. B's text sits a few pixels further left and its '>>>' is slightly smaller, which is not a meaningful difference.
